title: Attio two-tone statement
description: A heading in two tones: the opening clause in the main colour, the rest in slate grey, tightly tracked in the display face. Four sizes: hero (64px semibold), section (40px), statement (24px) and title (18px).
notes: the grey part can run on or start its own line (restOnNewLine)
name: attio-heading

props.name: lead
props.description: the opening clause, in the main text colour

props.name: rest
props.description: the rest of the thought, in slate grey (follows after a space)

props.name: restOnNewLine
props.description: start the grey part on its own line instead of running on

props.name: size
props.description:
hero: 40 → 64px semibold · section: 32 → 40px · statement: 24px (chapter lines) ·
title: 18px (small panels)
